label: repA101ts
note: repA101ts: the pSC101 replication initiation protein as carried by the curable Red helper plasmid pKD46 — the canonical rep allele with H289Y. Sequence of record: AY048746 (pKD46, Datsenko & Wanner 2000) CDS complement(3496..4446), protein AAL02049.1. It differs from the catalog's rep pSC101 (the native pSC101 allele of NC_002056) at exactly one residue, H289Y, and from UniProt P22308 at H257R. Datsenko & Wanner 2000 describe pKD46 as "an easily curable, low copy number plasmid" (abstract; the full text, with the growth and curing temperatures, was not accessible to verify here). Which residue makes pKD46's replication temperature-sensitive is NOT established here. Armstrong et al. 1984 located pSC101's temperature-sensitive, copy-number and replication-deficient mutations inside rep101 rather than in the origin, but give no residue, and the GenBank record names this CDS repA101 without stating a phenotype. No origin part in this catalog carries a temperature-sensitivity claim.

provenance.sequence_source: AY048746 (Red recombinase plasmid pKD46, Datsenko & Wanner 2000) CDS complement(3496..4446), protein AAL02049.1, identical over 316 aa

variant_rationale: The rep allele of pKD46, one residue (H289Y) from the native pSC101 protein: the difference is the point of the part, so the variant sequence is kept rather than normalised to the canonical allele.

functional_claims.label: Differs from the native pSC101 rep protein (NC_002056, catalog part rep pSC101) at one residue, H289Y; and from UniProt P22308 at H257R.
